verdict.rationale: Sift offers Review Queues and REST APIs. The Score API exposes risk scores and the Decisions API lets decisions be written back, so a custom agent could plausibly read risk context and post recommendations or decisions for human-confirmed review, which is the pattern the founder describes. Nothing in the evidence shows an API to list or pull queued cases with their full context, and there is no native AI or agent tooling. missing for 10: documented API access to review queue contents, case-context retrieval for flagged items, any agent/AI or MCP integration for summarization and recommendations, a documented 'recommend then human confirm' flow, and hands-on corroboration.
